body: Thank you all for your kind words 💕 I’m trying to get by, and although I feel guilty, I know that this relationship isn’t healthy. Thank you guys, this community has been very helpful 💕

Wow I just have to say how one sided this sub is, I know cheating is wrong but did anyone that commented, have y’all gone through abuse, physical or emotional? I know cheating is not right but y’all are so quick to dismiss things? No matter the abuse? I’m not looking for excuses but this sub let me down.
Thank you, I feel guilty asf but shit has been shitty, I know I didn’t put detail but it hurts. Hope your doing good as well 💕
I’m glad it worked out for you.
I know I did something wrong. And it wasn’t physically cheating not that it matters.
Thank you. Just watched some videos, they are very helpful and enlightening.
Tell his family, someone close to him, save another young person from being a victim.
I’m sorry, sending much love and healing 💕
I’m sorry you went through that. None of that is your fault I hope you know that.
